animal_level_bound.question: what is the prevalence if the unit is the animal rather than the observation?
animal_level_bound.assumption: each fattened kid was sampled up to three times and no kid was replaced; if replacements occurred, the distinct-animal count is larger and the bound below widens downward in denominator

distinct_positive_fattened_kids.why: 84 positive observations, at most 3 per kid, at most 50 kids

animal_level_bound.status: design-derived interval, not an observed count; do not publish as a point estimate and do not replace the seed row with it

review_level_consequence.caveat: arithmetic transparency only; the review's own footnote says rows are not directly comparable and this file does not endorse pooling
